acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI exposes a first-class channel step and selects dev when no value exists.
The selected channel persists across restart and is shown consistently in landing, status, install, upgrade, launch, and JSON projections.
Unknown or unavailable channels produce typed recovery without silently becoming dev or stable.
Development-only authentication, signatures, and key management are visible warnings and never block setup or launch.

definition_of_done: Keyboard, restart, human, and JSON cases pass at exact paired heads.
Independent review confirms channel selection does not introduce a hidden authentication gate.
A privacy-safe receipt records exact product identities and diagnostic outcomes.

inputs.description: The paired ASB channel vocabulary and current-main provenance contract.

outputs.description: TUI channel selection, persistence, unavailable-choice, and warning-only diagnostic receipt.

gates.description: Interactive and JSON TUI surfaces agree on channel selection, persistence, and typed diagnostics at exact paired heads.
